name: Voix Marocaine Test
consentText: Je confirme que j'ai l'autorisation d'utiliser cet enregistrement vocal et de créer une voix personnalisée à partir de celui-ci.

acousticProfile.detectedLanguage: Modern Standard Arabic with Moroccan accent influence
acousticProfile.accentOrDialect: Moroccan / Maghrebi accented Arabic, characterized by crisp alveolar stops, distinct pharyngeal articulation, clean dental fricatives, and subtle vowel reduction typical of Moroccan speech cadence.
acousticProfile.timbreDescription: Warm, clear, natural, slightly intimate, smooth, with balanced mid-range resonance and minimal vocal fry.
acousticProfile.cadenceAndPacing: Moderate and deliberate pacing, measured pauses between syntactic phrases, steady rhythmic cadence, and an informative, calm delivery style.
acousticProfile.acousticConditioningPrompt: Speak in a calm, clear, and warm adult female voice with an alto pitch register. Emulate a Moroccan Arabic acoustic profile featuring precise consonant enunciation, subtle Maghrebi cadence and stress patterns, smooth phonation, and a natural, conversational delivery without exaggerated theatricality or excessive vocal fry.
